servesPizza.name: Swel
servesPizza.note: A slightly upscale Fremont trattoria serving pastas, small plates and steaks, where the wood-fired pizzas, served with a spicy chili oil, are called out by reviewers as the kitchen's strongest dishes.

servesPizza.name: Trailbend Taproom
servesPizza.note: A Ballard craft-beer taproom with dozens of rotating taps whose kitchen runs a Wood Stone oven for wood-fired pizzas and flatbreads alongside sandwiches and salads.
